protected_invariants.heading: Primary Objective
protected_invariants.text: Create a coherent, visually rigorous deck that communicates one clear narrative, works interactively as a self-contained 16:9 HTML presentation, and can be exported predictably to exact-size PNG images and a visually faithful image-only PPTX when requested.

protected_invariants.heading: Start With the Output Choice
protected_invariants.text: 1. **Interactive HTML only** — editable source, keyboard navigation, deep links, fullscreen, and presenter notes.

protected_invariants.heading: Start With the Output Choice
protected_invariants.text: 3. **PPTX** — a widescreen, image-only PowerPoint assembled from the PNGs.

protected_invariants.heading: Start With the Output Choice
protected_invariants.text: Do not ask again when the request already names a format. If the user cannot decide, recommend HTML plus PNG for portability, or all formats when a conventional presentation file is a delivery requirement. Explain that the bundled PPTX workflow preserves appearance exactly but does not make individual slide elements editable.

protected_invariants.heading: Output Directory
protected_invariants.text: Treat the deck directory as one deliverable. Do not place exported `slide-*.png` files in `images/`; `images/` is reserved for deck-ready assets referenced by the HTML. Keep source notes or research beside the deck only when the user asks for them.

protected_invariants.heading: Discovery Inputs
protected_invariants.text: Gather only information that materially changes the deck. Use existing context instead of interrogating the user.

protected_invariants.heading: Discovery Inputs
protected_invariants.text: - core narrative and required sections

protected_invariants.heading: Discovery Inputs
protected_invariants.text: When evidence is incomplete, label assumptions and illustrative values explicitly. Never invent a source, quotation, customer claim, or measured result.

protected_invariants.heading: Workflow
protected_invariants.text: 6. **Validate the live DOM at the target viewport.** Check slide state, clipping, collisions, required wording, console errors, and interactive controls before trusting screenshots.

protected_invariants.heading: Workflow
protected_invariants.text: 7. **Export only when requested.** Produce PNGs in one browser process, verify every image, then build PPTX from the verified PNGs.

protected_invariants.heading: Narrative and Slide Design Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Prefer a few large elements over many small ones. Do not shrink text to rescue an overloaded slide; simplify the slide.

protected_invariants.heading: Narrative and Slide Design Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Avoid decorative gradients, shadows, or animation that compete with the story. Motion should clarify slide entry or focus and must be disabled for export.

protected_invariants.heading: Narrative and Slide Design Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Preserve whitespace. Never solve hierarchy by filling every available area.

protected_invariants.heading: HTML Architecture
protected_invariants.text: The runtime must maintain exactly one active slide during normal viewing. Implement:

protected_invariants.heading: HTML Architecture
protected_invariants.text: - visible next/previous controls that do not cover slide content

protected_invariants.heading: HTML Architecture
protected_invariants.text: Keep presentation state in a small, readable script. Do not add a framework for a single-file deck.

protected_invariants.heading: Image Asset Convention
protected_invariants.text: Use the following contract whenever a deck contains user-provided or locally generated image files. Do not invent, scrape, or silently download imagery.

protected_invariants.heading: Choose one delivery profile
protected_invariants.text: - **Single-file HTML (default):** keep deck-ready files under `images/` while authoring, then embed their bytes as data URIs in the final `index.html`. The delivered HTML must render correctly without the authoring directory.

protected_invariants.heading: Choose one delivery profile
protected_invariants.text: - **Portable package:** when the user approves local assets or embedding would make the HTML unreasonable, keep the files under `<deck-slug>/images/` and reference them only with relative paths such as `images/photo-team-workshop.webp`. The whole deck directory is the deliverable.

protected_invariants.heading: Choose one delivery profile
protected_invariants.text: Never leave absolute paths, `file://` URLs, temporary paths, or unapproved `http://`/`https://` image dependencies in the final HTML.

protected_invariants.heading: Prepare and name assets
protected_invariants.text: - Keep `images/` flat by default and store only deck-ready assets there. Keep untouched originals outside the deliverable.

protected_invariants.heading: Prepare and name assets
protected_invariants.text: - Use SVG for trusted diagrams and logos, WebP or JPEG for photographs, and PNG for screenshots or transparency. The extension must match the encoded format.

protected_invariants.heading: Prepare and name assets
protected_invariants.text: - Preserve source aspect ratio. Create a deck-ready copy for cropping, compression, metadata removal, or color adjustment; do not silently modify the user's original.

protected_invariants.heading: Prepare and name assets
protected_invariants.text: - Remove unneeded EXIF or GPS metadata before external distribution. Preserve attribution and license details in `<deck-slug>/ASSET-ATTRIBUTION.md` when they must travel with the deck, without copying private source URLs or credentials. Keep `images/` reserved for actual deck-ready image files.

protected_invariants.heading: Prepare and name assets
protected_invariants.text: - Treat SVG as active content: inline only trusted, sanitized SVG without scripts, event handlers, `foreignObject`, or external references. Otherwise load it through ``.

protected_invariants.heading: Use one semantic media component
protected_invariants.text: Use `` for meaningful imagery so alternative text and load failures remain inspectable. Use CSS backgrounds only for decorative texture, and mark decorative `` elements with `alt=""`.

protected_invariants.heading: Use one semantic media component
protected_invariants.text: Use `cover` for photographs intended to fill a frame. Use `contain` for screenshots, diagrams, charts, and logos that must remain fully visible. Adjust `--image-position` to preserve the focal point; never stretch an image to fit. Set slide images to `loading="eager"`; lazy loading is incompatible with deterministic export because inactive slides may never enter the viewport before validation.

protected_invariants.heading: Validate image assets
protected_invariants.text: The bundled PNG exporter performs this broken-image check after page load and aborts before taking screenshots. Do not treat a placeholder, missing image icon, or CSS background as a successful export.

protected_invariants.heading: Export Mode Contract
protected_invariants.text: Every deck intended for export must support an explicit `?export=1` mode and an equivalent `body.export` class. Export mode must hide interface chrome and remove nondeterministic motion while leaving slide content untouched.

protected_invariants.heading: Export Mode Contract
protected_invariants.text: The interactive URL without `?export=1` must restore controls, progress, and notes behavior. Test both modes; an export stylesheet that permanently hides controls is a defect.

protected_invariants.heading: Presenter Notes
protected_invariants.text: Store notes with each slide in a hidden `.speaker-note` element so notes travel with the standalone file. Render the active slide's notes into a separate notes panel only when the presenter toggles it.

protected_invariants.heading: Presenter Notes
protected_invariants.text: - do not expose hidden notes in PNG export

protected_invariants.heading: Validation
protected_invariants.text: Validate the actual page, not only the source text.

protected_invariants.heading: Structural checks
protected_invariants.text: - controls are visible interactively and hidden only in export mode

protected_invariants.heading: Geometry checks at 1920×1080
protected_invariants.text: Also check the browser console, required phrases, dates, units, business-context labels, citations, and caveats. A clean accessibility tree and correct DOM state are stronger evidence than a single screenshot.

protected_invariants.heading: PNG Export
protected_invariants.text: Use `--force` only when replacing existing `slide-*.png` files is intended. The exporter defaults to `.slide`, discovers the count in page JavaScript, adds `body.export`, waits briefly for native paint using the configurable settle delay, and fails on timeout or missing output.

protected_invariants.heading: PNG Export
protected_invariants.text: Use native OCR or image inspection for representative content when available, but do not treat OCR as a substitute for DOM geometry checks.

protected_invariants.heading: Cross-platform fallback
protected_invariants.text: If Playwright or Puppeteer is already part of the environment, use one browser process and one page, set the viewport once, activate slides sequentially, and capture each slide. Do not add a browser dependency merely for convenience without telling the user. Do not spawn one Chrome process per slide; that pattern is slow, can leave orphan processes, and becomes worse when parallelized.

protected_invariants.heading: PPTX Export
protected_invariants.text: Do not promise editable PPTX conversion unless a separate native-slide authoring workflow is explicitly requested and validated.

protected_invariants.heading: Optional Google Slides Delivery
protected_invariants.text: Only upload when the user explicitly requests Google Slides and the local `gws` CLI is authenticated. Convert the PPTX through Drive, dry-run first, then verify the presentation:

protected_invariants.heading: Optional Google Slides Delivery
protected_invariants.text: Run the same command without `--dry-run` only after reviewing the request. Verify with `gws slides presentations get` that page size is widescreen, slide count matches, and each image-only slide has exactly one image.

protected_invariants.heading: Known Failure Modes and Preferred Responses
protected_invariants.text: - **Stale DevTools screenshots:** a browser screenshot tool may return a stale compositor frame even when the DOM and accessibility tree show the correct active slide. Retry through a deterministic exporter and verify the output file; do not accept the stale capture as proof.

protected_invariants.heading: Known Failure Modes and Preferred Responses
protected_invariants.text: - **Single-pass print-to-PDF timeouts:** do not make PDF printing the default route to PNG. Snapshot slides individually in one loaded page.

protected_invariants.heading: Known Failure Modes and Preferred Responses
protected_invariants.text: - **Invalid bitmap configuration:** four samples per pixel with `hasAlpha: false` is inconsistent. The macOS exporter must use RGBA: `samplesPerPixel: 4` and `hasAlpha: true`.

protected_invariants.heading: Known Failure Modes and Preferred Responses
protected_invariants.text: - **Hidden interactive controls:** export-mode rules must be scoped under `body.export`, not applied globally.

protected_invariants.heading: Known Failure Modes and Preferred Responses
protected_invariants.text: - **Overflow rescued by tiny text:** do not reduce readability to pass bounds checks; split or simplify the slide.

protected_invariants.heading: Known Failure Modes and Preferred Responses
protected_invariants.text: - **Unlabeled sample data:** mark illustrative metrics and replace them before final delivery when factual evidence is required.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - forbidden: transmit private source material to third parties without authorization, invent evidence, silently scrape external assets, or claim export success without checking generated files

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Disable animation and hide controls only in explicit export mode.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Create PPTX only from verified PNGs.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Label flattened PPTX output as image-only and non-editable.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Use `images/` only for deck-ready referenced image files, with descriptive kebab-case names and relative paths; keep attribution metadata at deck root.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Never silently fetch imagery or distort an image to fit a frame.
